command: set +e; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); echo MEM; awk '/MemTotal|MemAvailable|SwapTotal|SwapFree/ {print}' /proc/meminfo; echo LOAD; cat /proc/loadavg; echo PSI_MEM; cat /proc/pressure/memory 2>/dev/null; echo PSI_IO; cat /proc/pressure/io 2>/dev/null; echo SYSTEMD_USER; systemctl --user is-system-running; echo SYSTEMD_RUN; command -v systemd-run; systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --unit=frank-hostbound-probe-$RANDOM -p MemoryMax=128M -p TasksMax=16 -p CPUQuota=50% -- bash -lc 'echo scope-ok; cat /proc/self/cgroup'; echo SCOPE_RC=$?; echo RAMWATCH; systemctl --user is-enabled frankenstein-ram-waechter.timer 2>&1; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-ram-waechter.timer 2>&1; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-ram-waechter.timer frankenstein-ram-waechter.service 2>&1 | head -120; echo SERVICES; systemctl --user --no-pager --type=service --state=running | grep -Ei 'frank|entity|bridge|voice|grid|memory' | head -60; echo REPO; git -C /home/andreas/self-integration status --short --branch 2>&1 | head -30; git -C /home/andreas/self-integration rev-parse HEAD 2>&1
